description: On a mountain farm on a sunny day, with a stone house, a stone wall and snowy peaks behind, a big shaggy male goat with a long beard and huge curved horns stands on the roof of a small old cream-coloured car. A young woman in a red checked shirt, green dungarees and rubber boots holds up a carrot to it, and the goat takes it, rears up on its back legs and lands on the roof again while she watches with her hands on her hips. More goats stand along the wall.

taps.phrase: to perch on a car roof

en.question: What is the billy goat standing on?
